items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for new public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or results, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; this is not a clean bill of health. Exact decision: preserve private and parked launch gates, reject new public launches, deployments, dependencies, telemetry expansion, credential or permission changes, and external outreach. Continue only existing read-only evidence, measurement, repair-or-close, and readiness work. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries.

Security evidence action: continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failed work, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

For the gated product, retain the private, preview-only gate. Public exposure, security-sensitive release, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, dependency additions, and external outreach remain blocked because material security evidence and separate rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete.
